Name: PerFarmhandWoods
Author: DerexSV
Description:
Per Farmhand Woods 0.1.1
========================

[b]Per Farmhand Woods[/b] gives every multiplayer guest their own Secret Woods. The host keeps the vanilla Woods. When a guest steps on the Forest entrance tiles, they’re smoothly routed to a personal Woods instance; exiting returns them to the Forest a couple tiles inward to avoid re-triggering. No commands or setup.

[b]New in 0.1.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a console command, [code]pfw_purge[/code], that deletes every [i]Woods_*[/i] instance, disables custom warps, and halts the mod’s save logic for the remainder of the session.
[*] Introduced runtime flags so all event handlers respect purge mode before attempting warps or persisting save data.
[*] Documented the purge workflow and uninstall steps in both English and Brazilian Portuguese READMEs.
[*] Translated remaining diagnostics and inline comments to English for consistent logging.
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Per-player Secret Woods:[/b] each farmhand gets [i]Woods_<theirUID>[/i], created on demand and reused across sessions.
[*] [b]Host stays vanilla:[/b] the host always enters the original Woods via the normal border warp.
[*] [b]Seamless entry/exit:[/b] guests go straight to their own instance; exits land slightly inward in the Forest to prevent re-trigger loops.
[*] [b]Save-safe & zero config:[/b] the host creates instances; nothing in the base save is overwritten; drop in and play.
[/list]

[b]How it works[/b]
[list]
[*] On host load / farmhand connect, the mod ensures a location named [i]Woods_<UID>[/i] exists (cloned from the vanilla Woods via the game’s location data).
[*] The Forest entrance tiles are given a custom [i]TouchAction[/i] ([code]DerexSV.PerFarmhandWoods.EnterWoods x y[/code]). For guests, it warps to [i]Woods_<UID>[/i]; for the host, it does nothing so the vanilla border warp handles entry.
[*] Personal Woods adjust their built-in exit warps to return to the Forest a couple tiles inward, avoiding immediate re-trigger.
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*] Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*] SMAPI 4.3.2+ (matches the mod’s manifest)
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*] Extract the mod folder into your [i]Mods[/i] directory.
[*] [b]Multiplayer:[/b] install on [u]host and all farmhands[/u] so the custom TouchAction is recognized client-side.
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*] Compatible with most content packs and map reskins.
[*] Mods that heavily edit [i]Maps/Forest*[/i] entrance tiles or replace the vanilla Woods warps may require load-order/patch priority tweaks.
[*] Festival versions of the Forest may disable the Woods entrance (vanilla behavior).
[/list]

[b]Known limitations[/b]
[list]
[*] If a guest reaches the entrance before the host’s instance is fully created, entry may fail once. Re-entering after a moment (or after the host finishes loading) resolves it.
[*] Uninstalling leaves any [i]Woods_<UID>[/i] locations in the save as unused areas. This is harmless, but back up your save if you plan to remove the mod.
[/list]

[b]Disabling / uninstalling[/b]
[list]
[*] Run [code]pfw_purge[/code] in the SMAPI console to remove all personal Woods, stop the mod’s saving, and disable the custom warps.
[*] Sleep to save the in-game day.
[*] Close the game and delete the mod folder before launching Stardew Valley again.
[/list]

[b]Troubleshooting[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Guest enters vanilla Woods:[/b] ensure the guest also has the mod installed and the host loaded the save first.
[*] [b]“Required location not found” on entry:[/b] the host didn’t finish creating the instance yet. Try again shortly and verify both sides are up-to-date with SMAPI and this mod.
[/list]

[b]Source & issues[/b]
[list]
[*] GitHub repository: [url=https://github.com/Jadiael1/PerFarmhandWoods]github.com/Jadiael1/PerFarmhandWoods[/url]
[/list]

[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*] DerexSV — concept and implementation.
[*] Thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI community, and Pathoschild for the tooling.
[/list]
